newsitem.title: UK: IATA to challenge UK limits on airport noise - FT.
newsitem.headline: IATA to challenge UK limits on airport noise - FT.

text.p: New noise limits set by the UK government for three London airports are to be challenged by the International Air Transport Association, the Financial Times reported.
The newspaper quoted IATA's director general Pierre Jeanniot as saying the association planned quick action to "get a judge to put a stay on the rule".
Revised noise limits for departing aircraft at Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted airports were announced in August and are to take effect in January.
Jeanniot said the new limits were impossibly low and airlines would have little option but to exceed them on almost every take-off -- and incur heavy fines.
